create.about_roll: Assign the standard values (15, 14, 13, 12, 10, 8). They start arranged for your class. Pick two scores in a row to swap them.
create.about_point_buy: Every score starts at 8. Spend 27 points with Left/Right to raise or lower them (max 15).
create.about_skills: Choose the skills your class gains.
create.about_freeabilities: Choose the ability scores to get +1 (Half-Elf).
create.about_alignment: Alignment affects how characters respond in stories and events. It does not affect strength.

party.empty: No party members (add them at the Tavern)
town.title: The Town Above
town.confirm_quit: Save and return to the title?
town.about_tavern: Gather companions and form a party. The first three are the front row, the rest the back row. Only the front row can melee.
town.about_inn: Stay the night and take a long rest. HP is restored.
town.about_shop: Buy and sell gear and items, identify items, and remove curses. Purchases are paid from party gold; sale proceeds are shared.
town.about_temple: Resurrect dead companions, or cure poison, paralysis and more. A failed resurrection turns the body to ashes, and failing again on ashes loses the character.
town.about_training: Create, inspect, level up, rename or delete characters.
town.about_maze: Enter the maze with your party. The up stairs on B1 lead back to town.
town.about_maze_no_party: You need a party that can act to enter the maze. Create characters at the Training Grounds, then add them at the Tavern.
town.about_quit: Save and return to the title screen.
tavern.about_main: The party holds up to 6. The first three are the front row.

inn.stable_about: Sleep on straw. HP recovers to half.
inn.room_about: Rest in a bed. HP fully recovers.

options.title: Options
ai.title: AI Settings
ai.paste_bad: The clipboard has no Claude API key (text starting with sk-ant-). Copy it first, then choose this.
ai.saved: The key is stored in Windows Credential Manager.
ai.deleted_env: The stored key was deleted (a key in the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable remains).
ai.about: With a Claude API key, the AI writes text for each new world when you start a new game: a prologue, floor names and the lines shown on entering them, and writings found in the dungeon. The story, monsters, treasure and dungeon layout do not change. The text is saved, so loading never calls the AI again. It is called once per new game and Anthropic charges for it.
ai.about_key: The key is kept in Windows Credential Manager, never in the options or saves. Without a key, or when the AI cannot be reached, the game uses its built-in text.

ai.world_cancel: Cancel to stop and start with the built-in text
